about: SolvedNumber.clean (jvm/core/core-base): [input, answer, what] as 64-bit hex patterns, written by hand. A solved value becomes the nearest double to the first continued-fraction convergent p/q of it with q <= 100000 that lies within 1e-12 relative of it and within 1e-4 / q^2 absolute; any other value stays. Held bit for bit by SolvedNumberTest on the JVM and by tools/web-core on both web targets, in the core module and the solver module.
